title: RBI Summer Internship Scheme 2027
summary: Up to 125 students intern at Reserve Bank of India offices on economics, banking, finance and legal projects for 8–10 weeks between April and July.
eligibility: PG students and students of 5-year integrated courses in management, statistics, law, commerce, economics, econometrics, banking or finance; 3-year LLB students at reputed Indian institutions. Penultimate-year students apply for summer placement.

prize.description: ₹20,000 per month (2026 scheme), subject to RBI rules.

notes: The 2026 cycle closed on 15 December 2025, with interviews in January–February. Expect the 2027 call around November–December 2026.
Upload a bonafide certificate, statement of purpose and preferred research areas; details cannot be edited after submission.
